title: Cosmology with Logarithmic Corrected Horizon Entropy According to the Generalized Entropy and Variable-G Correspondence
summary: According to the GEVAG (Generalized Entropy Varying-G) framework, any modification to the Bekenstein-Hawking area law would also lead to a varying-$G$ gravity theory in which the effective gravitational constant $G_\text{eff}$ becomes area-dependent. Among a myriad of generalized entropy functions explored in the literature, of special interest is the logarithmic correction of quantum gravity.
